Hi James —

Great to meet you and the team on today's call. Quick recap and a few questions so we can align the trial -> paid path:

Recap
- We'll provision a 30-day trial environment for your core search and summarization flows.
- Goal: validate latency & cost improvements on customer-facing summary pipeline and two internal automation flows.
- Redwood will provide a sandbox workspace, onboarding guide, and weekly check-ins.

Procurement / commercial questions
1) Paper process: do you require a PO and standard SOW for pilots, or can we run on a corporate card for the initial period?
2) Marketplace: you mentioned interest in an AWS Marketplace listing — would you prefer procurement via marketplace billing (faster procurement) or a direct contract with Redwood?
3) Billing start: would you like billing to start on a fixed date (e.g., Nov 1) or upon hitting agreed success criteria? If success criteria, what thresholds would you use (tokens, integrations, performance metrics)?

Success criteria suggestion (for discussion)
- >= 500k generated tokens in product flows OR
- 3 product integrations validated and 7-day stability window with no P0 performance regressions

I've attached a short MPA and our standard pricing sheet for reference. If you can loop in your procurement contact (name & email) I'll coordinate contracting and propose a mutual action plan.

Next steps
- Please confirm PO vs card, procurement contact, and preferred billing trigger.
- I'll draft a simple MAP and estimate for AWS Marketplace listing if that's the preferred route.

Thanks —

Marissa Cole

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the recap and the materials — helpful. Answers below:

1) Paper process: For anything above $10k we're required to issue a PO. For pilot spend below $10k we can use a corporate card. That said, we usually prefer a PO/SOW even for pilots when there's any expectation of scaling.

2) Marketplace: We do prefer AWS Marketplace from a procurement perspective because it bypasses our contracting team for GTM/ops reasons. That said, marketplace listing requires a public pricing SKU and our procurement team will still need confirmation that the contract terms are standard. If you can provide a marketplace-friendly pricing line and an estimate, we'll evaluate that route.

3) Billing start: Prefer billing to start on a mutually agreed date. For this pilot we'd like to start billing Nov 1 if the trial proves successful; otherwise we'll convert to paid earlier if we hit success criteria. Our internal success criteria are typically:
   - >= 500k generated tokens across the pilot flows OR
   - Completion of 3 product-specific validation tests (search relevance, summary accuracy, and latency under load)

Procurement contact: procurement@stellar.ai (Procurement team inbox). Point of contact is Priya Singh (Priya.Singh@stellar.ai) — she'll issue PO and confirm vendor terms.

Happy to jump back on a 20-min sync if you want to lock down the mutual action plan and dates.

Cheers,
James
Senior Product Manager, Stellar Analytics
james.patel@stellar.ai

Hi James / Priya —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and for sharing Priya's contact. Confirming next steps from Redwood:

1) I'll draft a short pilot SOW and send a DocuSign link by EOD tomorrow. That SOW will propose:
   - 30-day trial environment starting Oct 20 with billing to begin Nov 1 conditional on conversion, or earlier if Stellar elects to convert upon meeting success criteria.
   - Success criteria options (we can finalize): 500k generated tokens OR 3 validated product tests.

2) Procurement options:
   - Marketplace: we'll prepare an AWS Marketplace SKU and a marketplace-friendly price line for your review. This typically speeds procurement but does require public SKU pricing.
   - Direct: if Stellar prefers a PO, we'll accept PO and attach the SOW to the invoice; please provide PO number and billing contact when ready.

3) MAP & monitoring:
   - I'll share a one-page mutual action plan with milestones (onboarding, integrations, validation tests, billing start).
   - We'll instrument usage dashboards and send weekly usage updates; if you prefer, I can also set up an auto-alert when we hit 250k and 500k tokens.

Please confirm the PO owner and any special contract clauses (data residency, IP, or indemnity) your procurement team needs us to acknowledge. If nothing special, we'll send standard terms and the marketplace option.

If you want to lock dates now, we can plan onboarding starting Oct 20 and aim to have contracts executed by Oct 28 to meet a Nov 1 billing start.

I'll follow up with the SOW + DocuSign and the marketplace pricing line.

Best,
